item.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
item.description: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

item.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
item.description: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.

item.title: Nectar launches an AI agent to automate creator discovery and outreach for brands
item.description: Nectar's new AI agent automates influencer marketing, helping brands discover creators, manage outreach and partnerships, and track campaign results.

item.title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
item.description: Rather than giving consumers yet another photo-editing tool, Phota Labs aims to use advances in AI to automate the editing process so it’s easier for anyone to turn everyday moments into better photos.

item.title: Nine Korean startups vie for a spot in Disrupt 2027’s Startup Battlefield 200 competition
item.description: The startups work across the deep tech sector, including healthcare, fintech, energy, semiconductors, and AI. All nine are looking to enter the U.S.

item.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
item.description: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.

item.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
item.description: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

item.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
item.description: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

item.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
item.description: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

item.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
item.description: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.

item.title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry
item.description: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. item.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
item.description: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

item.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
item.description: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

item.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
item.description: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

item.title: Zipline hits $21.5B valuation as Walmart expands bet on drone delivery
item.description: Zipline raised $1.5 billion and ramped up its partnership with Walmart.

item.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
item.description: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

item.title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
item.description: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.

item.title: Nothing CEO says company’s mysterious AI-first device is dropping next month
item.description: While it's not yet clear what kind of product the smartphone startup is cooking up, Nothing's CEO said the product is designed to leverage AI for productivity gains.
